_source:
Curriculum Development Centre Teaching Module — "Hospitality Management Teaching Module Form1 - Term 2" (https://library.cdcrepository.info/resource.php?id=302). Topic/sub-topic structure and competencies extracted with AI assistance (Gemini) directly from this module's own stated content — never invented; the extraction was instructed to use only what the module itself says, and to flag anything unclear rather than guess. Covers only the term this specific module addresses (Term 2) — other terms are not included since no source document for them was available at extraction time. AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: General competences were explicitly provided for major topic headers (1.3 and 1.4) while sub-topics explicitly provided single 'Specific Competence' statements, extracted directly. Formatting contains minor numbering typos in the original text (e.g., duplicate 'Learning Activity 4' headings in Topic 1.3.4), but all topic structures and sub-topics were parsed as explicitly named.

ADDED (2026-09-08): a real, complete 'Hospitality Management Scheme of Work, Form 1, Term 1-3' (a real Zambian secondary school; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive, citing 'Hospitality Management Syllabus 2024' throughout. New Term 1 (1.1 Introduction to Hospitality, 1.2 Front Office Operations) is this document's own content wholesale -- this app had no Term 1 content at all before. New Term 3 and the two topics appended to the existing Term 2 (1.4 Cosmetology, 1.5 Ethics and Entrepreneurship) are this same document's own genuinely new subject matter (Cosmetology and Entrepreneurship do not appear anywhere in this file's original CDC-Teaching-Module-sourced Term 2 content).

REAL, DISCLOSED CONFLICTS, not resolved by guessing: (1) this same document's own Term 1 also contains a '1.3 Housekeeping Operations' topic and its own Term 2 contains a '1.4 Food and Beverage Operations' topic (weeks 1-8) -- both are NOT included here because their real content (hygiene, safety, nutrition, cookery basics, room/facility care) already substantively duplicates this file's own, differently-numbered, originally-CDC-Teaching-Module-sourced Term 2 topics ('TOPIC: 1.3 FOOD AND BEVERAGE OPERATIONS', 'TOPIC: 1.4 HOUSE KEEPING OPERATIONS'). (2) This document's own topic numbering genuinely collides with the numbering already established from that other real source -- its own 'Cosmetology' and 'Entrepreneurship' content is itself labelled '1.4'/'1.5' in the source, which numerically coincides with this file's pre-existing, differently-themed '1.4 Housekeeping' topic from the OTHER real source. Both real placements are kept exactly as their own source states them rather than silently renumbering either one to hide the coincidence.

subject.name: Hospitality Management
subject.description: Hospitality Management syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 1.1.1 Historical Overview
sub_topics.description: Hospitality in lodging, food and beverage, travel and tour, recreation and entertainment, event management; history of the hospitality industry from ancient times through the enlightenment.

sub_topics.name: 1.1.2 Traditional and Modern Hospitality Practices in Zambia

competencies.description: Apply traditional and modern hospitality practices

sub_topics.description: Traditional and modern social, cultural and organizational hospitality norms in Zambia.

sub_topics.name: 1.1.3 Benefits of the Hospitality Industry

competencies.description: Explore benefits of the hospitality industry

sub_topics.description: Relationship-building, cultural exchange, and memorable-experience benefits of the hospitality industry.

sub_topics.name: 1.1.4 Departments of the Hospitality Facility

competencies.description: Analyse departments of the hospitality facility

sub_topics.description: Front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, and supporting departments of a hospitality facility.

sub_topics.name: 1.2.1 Perform Roles of the Front Office

competencies.description: Identify front office personnel and roles

sub_topics.description: Front office personnel, personal hygiene/appearance, and professional characteristics.

sub_topics.name: 1.2.2 Front Office Equipment
sub_topics.description: Property management systems, key card/surveillance systems, and payment/billing equipment.

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.3 FOOD AND BEVERAGE OPERATIONS
topics.description: Food and Beverage Operations refer to the processes involved in the preparation, service, and management of food and drinks in various hospitality settings such as restaurants, hotels, cafeterias, and event venues. It is a dynamic field that combines creativity, customer service, and operational efficiency to ensure a seamless dining experience for customers.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.3.1 Food and Beverage Operation
sub_topics.description: Encompasses the preparation, production, service, and delivery of food and drinks to customers, including kitchen operations, restaurant service, and bar management.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of Food and Beverage operations

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.3.2 Hygiene Practices in the Cooking Area
sub_topics.description: Focuses on maintaining proper hygiene standards, pest control, waste management, equipment maintenance, and personal hygiene practices to prevent food contamination and foodborne illnesses.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of hygiene practices in the cooking area

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.3.3 Safety and Security in the Cooking Area
sub_topics.description: Covers practicing safe work routines, personal protective equipment, knife and fire safety, chemical handling, safety signs, and emergency response procedures in the kitchen.

competencies.description: Practice safety and security in the cooking area

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.3.4 Nutrition in Cookery
sub_topics.description: Explores key cookery and nutrition terminology, dietary guidelines, macro and micronutrients, meal planning principles, and preparing healthy meals for special diets.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.3.5 Introduction to Cookery
sub_topics.description: Introduces fundamental cookery principles and equipment classification, including eating, serving, preparation, bar, specialty, cooking, refrigeration, and traditional kitchen utensils.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.3.6 Methods of Cooking
sub_topics.description: Details the application of heat to food through moist methods, dry methods, combination methods, and specialized cooking techniques like sous vide, smoking, pickling, and curing.

competencies.description: Apply a variety of methods of cooking

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.3.7 Basic Cookery Skills
sub_topics.description: Focuses on practical kitchen techniques including mis en place, knife skills and basic cuts, stock making, preparing starch/fat/protein thickening agents, and basic mother sauces.

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.4 HOUSE KEEPING OPERATIONS
topics.description: This topic covers the critical aspects of cleanliness, hygiene, and safety measures in the housekeeping department essential for maintaining a healthy and safe environment for both guests and staff.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.4.1 Cleanliness, Hygiene and Safety in Housekeeping Department
sub_topics.description: Covers pest identification, handling cleaning chemicals safely, implementing the 3Rs of waste management, and executing integrated pest control methods.

competencies.description: Apply cleanliness, hygiene and safety measures in housekeeping

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.4.2 Housekeeping Operations
sub_topics.description: Addresses organizational structures in housekeeping, roles of various staff, professional personnel characteristics, and personal hygiene standards for staff.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.4.3 Cleaning Operations
sub_topics.description: Focuses on routine cleaning schedules, cleaning specific functional areas, applying cleaning methods, selecting appropriate cleaning agents, and step-by-step bed making.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.4.4 Interior and Exterior Decoration in Hospitality Facility
sub_topics.description: Explores aesthetic color schemes, principles and elements of interior design, grouping display arrangements, and outdoor landscaping and gardening techniques.

competencies.description: Develop skills in interior and exterior decorations

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.4.5 Introduction to Laundry Processes
sub_topics.description: Covers fiber and fabric identification, manual and mechanical laundry equipment, laundry agents, stain removal techniques, care label reading, and household laundry workflows.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.7 History of Cosmetology

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of history of cosmetology

sub_topics.description: Background and gradual development of cosmetology from ancient civilisations to the contemporary era.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.8 Introduction to Cosmetology Practices
sub_topics.description: Components (hair styling, aesthetics, nail technology, barbering) and importance of cosmetology.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.9 Tools and Equipment in Cosmetology

competencies.description: Make use of tools and equipment in cosmetology

sub_topics.description: Hair, make-up, and sanitising tools/equipment used in cosmetology.

sub_topics.name: 1.5.1 Identify Business Opportunities
sub_topics.description: Entrepreneurship as a key competency; qualities of an entrepreneur; real business opportunities in hospitality.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.10 Professional Practices in Cosmetology
sub_topics.description: Client consultation, professional appearance, salon protocols, and health and safety in cosmetology.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.11 Advanced Nutrition and Meal Planning

competencies.description: Apply advanced nutrition in meal planning

sub_topics.description: Special dietary meal planning, cost-effective and sustainable meal planning, seasonal menus.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.12 Advanced Cookery Techniques
sub_topics.description: Plating/presentation, advanced sauces, specialised cooking methods, recipe development, food cost analysis.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.13 Food Service and Beverage Service

competencies.description: Demonstrate food and beverage service skills

sub_topics.description: Table setting/etiquette, service procedures, beverage service, service styles, guest interaction.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.14 Menu Planning and Design
sub_topics.description: Menu types, planning considerations, design elements, terminology, pricing and menu engineering.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.15 Food Costing and Cost Control
sub_topics.description: Food cost percentage, recipe costing, portion control, waste management, pricing strategies.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.16 Food Commodities and Sourcing

competencies.description: Employ various food commodities in cookery

sub_topics.description: Classification of food commodities, quality standards, supplier relationships, storage and preservation.

sub_topics.name: 1.5.2 Develop Business Skills
sub_topics.description: Business planning basics, record keeping, customer service, marketing, legal/regulatory requirements.

sub_topics.name: 1.5.3 Small Business Management
sub_topics.description: Business structure, operations, human resource management, quality control, growth and sustainability.

sub_topics.name: 1.5.4 Entrepreneurial Practice
sub_topics.description: Identifying opportunities, feasibility analysis, resource planning, risk assessment, innovation.
